BALSAMIFERUM Webb & Berthelot, 1840 香馥
名字来源于拉丁文"balsamum"意为香脂,取词义拟名"香馥(fù)".

©Daniel Grobbel-Rank
Synonym :
异名:
Sempervivum balsamiferum (Webb & Berthelot) Webb ex Christ (1888)
Section Aeonium
莲花掌组
Distribution : Canary Islands (Nothern and Central Lanzarote, naturalized in Fuerteventura).
分布:加那利群岛(兰萨罗特岛北部及中部,原生于富埃特文图岛.)
Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述(根据IHSP,2003)
Perennial rather few-branched subshrubs to 1.5 m, with resinous scent.
多年生树状亚灌木,高1.5m左右,有树脂香味.
Branches ± erect or ascending, often in groups, 8 - 20 mm in diameter, glabrous, smooth, without reticulations.
枝干直立,易群生,茎干直径8 - 20mm,顺滑无纹.
Rosette 7 - 18 cm in diameter, center flattened with young leaves tightly appressed to each other.
莲座状叶直径7 - 18cm,生长点叶片扁平互相紧贴.
Leaves 3 - 7 x 1.5 - 3.5 cm, 1.5 - 3 mm thick, narrowly obtrullate to obtrullate-spatulate, apically mucronate, basally cuneate, glabrous, margin with curved cilia (0.5 - 1 mm), greyish green, occasionally with some brownish stripes along the margin.
叶3 - 7片,长1.5 - 3.5长,1.5 - 3mm厚,狭倒镘形或匙形倒镘形,先端短尖,基部楔形,无毛,边缘有弯曲的纤毛(0.5 - 1mm),通常为灰绿色,有时叶缘附近有棕色条纹.
Inflorescences 15 – 25 x 14 - 20 cm, peduncle 8 - 15 cm, pedicels 2 - 12 mm, glabrous.
花序15 - 25枝,14 - 20cm,花序梗8 - 15cm,花梗2 - 12mm,无毛.
Flowers 7- to 8-merous, sepals glabrous, petals 6 – 8 x 1.2 - 1.5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate, yellow, filaments glabrous.
花基数7 - 8,萼片无毛,花瓣6 - 8片,长1.2 - 1.5mm,披针形,渐尖,花丝无毛.

©sftrajanAeonium balsamiferum香馥,身带清馥,曳音似燕喃.天生优雅,亭亭青衫优伶.女神级别的香馥,不论是其优雅婀娜的株型,冷清轻郁的香气,还是磨砂般的叶片,都美得不可方物.
君喜花开香袭人,熟知穷冬叶落尽,偏偏是这样一个女神,却在如此环境中兀自美丽.
